title: Find the Duplicate (Floyd's Cycle)
summary: Find the repeated value in an array of n values from 1 to n-1 by treating each value as a pointer to an index: the repeat is where the pointer chain enters a loop, found with a slow and a fast pointer.

inputs.name: values
inputs.label: Array values
inputs.note: n values from 1 to n-1, so at least one repeats (at least 2 values).

anchors.label: Slow one step, fast two steps
Slow moves one step, fast two
